name: strict-verification-evidence
note: Mandatory shape of VERIFICATION_REGISTRY.json under the Arena-only operating model (see docs/STRICT_VERIFICATION_GATE.md). The gate pins these lists to its own canonical contract (V-12 + V-13): editing this file alone cannot weaken the gate, and adding a key here without adding it to the gate's canonical list fails the pin.

evidence_semantics.reviewer: Arena; must equal the slot the evidence is attached to (V-09)
evidence_semantics.kind: evidence class; an item claiming RUNTIME_VERIFIED or above needs >=1 positive/runtime AND >=1 negative/adversarial/failure_recovery (V-11); a blocked/untested item needs only the review note that explains why
evidence_semantics.command: reproducible command; may not be solely a self-certification module (V-08)
evidence_semantics.exit_code: must be 0 — a run that failed is not evidence, it is a recorded failure (V-02)
evidence_semantics.checks_passed: integer, 0 <= checks_passed <= checks_total; must EQUAL checks_total for every entry (V-02)
evidence_semantics.artifact: repo-relative path; the file must exist in the working tree AND its exact bytes must exist in the evidence commit (V-02)
evidence_semantics.sha256: sha256 hex of the artifact bytes as committed at head_sha; a hash of uncommitted bytes is rejected (V-02)
evidence_semantics.head_sha: 40-hex immutable source commit on which the evidence was produced; normally equals checkout HEAD. For a metadata-only registry commit, may equal its parent only when the gate proves docs/verification/VERIFICATION_REGISTRY.json is the sole changed path. All item, evidence, and human-governance bindings must agree on that evidence SHA; ancestry still checks checkout HEAD (V-02/V-06/V-14).

human_governance.semantics: OPTIONAL annotation; no gate check reads it. Owner ruling 2026-10-27 retired V-10: the project owner exercises oversight directly on the repository and a per-registry signature is not a condition for passing the Strict Verification Gate. A registry MAY still record a decision here, and if it does, head_sha should equal the immutable evidence SHA so the annotation cannot mislead. This changes nothing about evidence: V-02/V-14/V-06 binding, V-11/V-12 schema and completeness, G14/V-01 expected_ids, V-17 witness scoping, V-18 status reach, V-15/V-15b headline ceilings, V-16 and the G7 false-green scanner are all still enforced.

false_green_allowlist_entry.semantics: pattern must be a known scanner label; expires is 'never' or a future date; optional path scopes approval to one file so gate-internal literals cannot blanket-approve the repo (V-07)

verdict_rules.slot: item.arena — the only reviewer slot under the Arena-only model (G5)
verdict_rules.verdicts: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED; every verdict needs its own evidence array (G10)
verdict_rules.pass_requires: reviews_recorded.arena non-empty + item.reviews contains arena + evidence[].reviewer == arena (V-09)
verdict_rules.non_pass_ceiling: a FAIL/BLOCKED verdict can never sit next to RUNTIME_VERIFIED or above; blocked=true pins the item to UNKNOWN and requires blocked_reason + owner_decision_required (V-13)

registry_status_bounds.ceiling: the registry status may not exceed the weakest recorded item (V-15)
registry_status_bounds.blocked: if any item is blocked, the registry status may not exceed TESTED (V-15b)
registry_status_bounds.nothing_verified: a registry with no item in the verifying band is NOT VERIFIED and the gate exits 1 even when every structural check passes (V-16)

completeness.expected_ids: must be non-empty, duplicate-free, contain every item id, and be fully present in items — missing, duplicated and undeclared ids are each named (G14a..G14d, G8)
completeness.independence: with one reviewer slot the pairwise-distinct checks (V-03/G16) are structurally vacuous; independence is not obtainable from AI review and the empty slot must not be re-invented (V-12)
